Hi Caroline,

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciated the clear priorities. As promised, attaching the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for Novafin (Novafin_MAP_v1.2.xlsx). Below is a short post-call recap and proposed next steps.

Quick recap:
- Primary use case: inference for customer support triage (short-text classification + reranking)
- Key non-functional priorities: predictable latency (<= 150ms p95), cost per 1K messages, and SOC2 evidence for third-party inference calls
- Procurement timeline: Novafin aims to finalize vendor by end of Q3; target close date listed below

Proposed MAP highlights (see attached for full milestone table):
- Milestone 1: Tech evaluation (POC) — Redwood to deliver a 2-week POC environment + onboarding guide. (Owner: Marissa / Redwood) — Target: 2028-07-25
- Milestone 2: Security review — provide SOC2, network architecture note, and answer questionnaire. (Owner: Novafin / Novafin Sec) — Target: 2028-07-29
- Milestone 3: Pricing/Commercial review & PO issuance (Owner: Novafin procurement + Redwood sales) — Target: 2028-08-05
- Milestone 4: Pilot go-live & monitoring baseline (Owner: Novafin Eng + Redwood SRE) — Target: 2028-08-15

Dependencies & open items:
- Novafin to provide security questionnaire and current data retention policy (Dependency: Novafin Sec)
- Network firewall rules for on-prem connector (Dependency: Novafin infra)

Attachments: Novafin_MAP_v1.2.xlsx
